original_inputs:
Create an internal FAQ from the following materials.

Employee question 1: When will the new hybrid-work arrangement begin?
Confirmed information: The pilot begins on October 7 and lasts eight weeks. Employees participating in the pilot must work from the office at least two days per week.

Employee question 2: Which teams will participate in the first phase?
Confirmed information: The first phase includes the Product, Design, and Customer Success teams.

Employee question 3: Will additional commuting support be provided?
The available materials contain no new decision about commuting support. The Human Resources team will provide separate guidance before the pilot begins.

Employee question 4: Will the arrangement become permanent after the pilot?
No decision has been made about permanent adoption. The company will evaluate employee feedback and data from the eight-week pilot.
